item.text: Voy a contar los eventos por hora leyendo el CSV sin modificarlo. Mostraré solo las horas y los conteos, sin imprimir tokens ni usar la red.
Usaré la habilidad de hojas de cálculo para este conteo descriptivo.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B -c 'import csv
import io
import json
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(\"/Users/leonardopadilla/Documents/USFQ/3er Semestre/Progra. Asistida de Apps/ClaseApps.worktrees/semana12-cyber-detective/Semana12/logs_sinteticos.csv\")
try:
    content = path.read_bytes()
    data = content.decode(\"utf-8-sig\")
    try:
        dialect = csv.Sniffer().sniff(data[:65536], delimiters=\",;\\t|\")
    except csv.Error:
        dialect = csv.excel
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(data), dialect=dialect)
    names = reader.fieldnames or []
    accepted = (\"timestamp\", \"datetime\", \"date_time\", \"fecha_hora\", \"time\", \"fecha\", \"event_time\", \"@timestamp\")
    matching = [(candidate, name) for candidate in accepted for name in names if name.strip().casefold() == candidate]
    if not matching:
        print(json.dumps({\"error\": \"No se identifico una columna temporal conocida; no se imprimieron datos del CSV.\"}))
        raise SystemExit(1)
    column = matching[0][1]
    counts = Counter()
    offsets = Counter()
    total = missing = invalid = 0
    for row in reader:
        total += 1
        raw = row.get(column)
        if raw is None or not raw.strip():
            missing += 1
            continue
        try:
            value = datetime.fromisoformat(raw.strip().replace(\"Z\", \"+00:00\"))
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            invalid += 1
            continue
        offset = value.utcoffset()
        offset_key = \"sin_zona\" if offset is None else str(int(offset.total_seconds()))
        offsets[offset_key] += 1
        key = value.replace(minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0).isoformat(timespec=\"minutes\")
        counts[key] += 1
    print(json.dumps({\"total_eventos\": total, \"sin_fecha\": missing, \"fecha_invalida\": invalid, \"zonas\": dict(offsets), \"por_hora\": dict(sorted(counts.items())), \"suma_conteos\": sum(counts.values()), \"archivo_sin_cambios\": path.read_bytes() == content}, ensure_ascii=False))
except SystemExit:
    raise
except Exception:
    print(json.dumps({\"error\": \"No se pudo completar el conteo. Se omitieron detalles para evitar exponer valores del CSV.\"}))
    raise SystemExit(1)
'"
